title: Pluto in Enhanced Color
explanation:
# Pluto's Hidden Rainbow

When NASA's New Horizons spacecraft zoomed past Pluto in 2015, it revealed a dwarf planet far more vibrant than any telescope could show—scientists artificially enhanced the color data to expose hidden chemical differences across its surface, revealing that this distant, icy world is surprisingly young and geologically active. The famous heart-shaped feature on Pluto turned out to be two distinct regions, with one remarkably smooth plain suggesting that geological processes have been reshaping this frozen world long after we expected everything out there to have gone cold and quiet billions of years ago.
